name: anderson
description: Gated maker/checker pipeline: plan (high) -> grill (you harden it) -> plan-review -> [human] -> implement (medium) -> diff-review (read-only) -> [human], then ship (commit + PR). Review effort is tiered off the plan Scorecard: trivial skips plan-review, critical runs both gates at xhigh. Self-contained agents; no external skills required.
